changes.text: In 2025, the company sold substantially all operating assets to Biamp Systems and ceased selling products, presenting the disposed business as discontinued operations.
changes.evidence: On October 24, 2025, the Company completed the sale of substantially all of its operating intellectual property, product inventory, and related production assets to Biamp Systems, LLC ("Biamp") for gross cash consideration of $ 3,000 (the "Asset Sale").
